segments.contextAfter: VoiceOver may no longer be able to access web content when moving backward or forward through the current Safari tab’s history. segments.contextAfter: StoreKit now supports subscription offers in addition to introductory offers, so apps with auto-renewable subscriptions can provide a discounted price for a specific duration for existing and previously subscribed customers.
